2609.18612.title: Weakening Neurons: An Input-Output Functionality in Transformers with Outsize Influence
2609.18612.paper_summary: We analyze the learned input-output behavior of GLU-based neurons in large language models (LLMs). We propose a simple analysis method: For each neuron, we compute the cosine similarities between its input (reading) and output (writing) weight vectors. In this scheme, a strong negative cosine similarity indicates the neuron weakens the direction it detects in the residual stream, so we call this a weakening neuron. This allows us to gain a number of novel insights. First, we show that nine different LLMs have similar patterns: weakening neurons appear mostly in late layers whereas their counterparts, (conditional) strengthening neurons, are frequent in early-middle layers. Second, we find that weakening neurons display surprising behavior: even though there are few, they activate often and have a large influence on model behavior. Third, weakening neurons have a strong effect on model output when gate values are negative -- which is surprising since negative gate values are not expected to encode functionality.
2609.18612.paper_summary_zh: 我們分析了基於 GLU 的神經元在大型語言模型 (LLMs) 中學習到的輸入-輸出行為。<lb/>我們提出了一種簡單的分析方法：對於每個神經元，我們計算其輸入（閱讀）和輸出（寫作）權重向量之間的餘弦相似度。<lb/>在這種方案中，強負的餘弦相似度表明該神經元削弱了其在殘差流中檢測到的方向，因此我們稱之為削弱神經元。<lb/>這使我們獲得了一些新的見解。<lb/>首先，我們顯示出九種不同的 LLMs 具有相似的模式：削弱神經元主要出現在後期層，而它們的對應物（條件）增強神經元則在早期到中期層中頻繁出現。<lb/>其次，我們發現削弱神經元顯示出驚人的行為：儘管數量不多，但它們經常被激活，並對模型行為產生了很大的影響。<lb/>第三，當閘值為負時，削弱神經元對模型輸出有強烈影響——這令人驚訝，因為負閘值並不預期會編碼功能。
